applicabilityBasis.summary: DLLR is expressly marketed for payments and as a 1:1 dollar-pegged stablecoin. Mynt creates and burns it against a basket of Bitcoin-backed stablecoins; holders exchange it for underlying digital assets or dollar-equivalent Bitcoin. The Sovryn terms disclaim being a transaction counterparty or custodian. No identified issuer obligation to redeem into national currency or a bank deposit is evidenced. GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability therefore remains unclear, rather than being inferred from payment marketing alone.

genius.notes: No legal token-issuer entity or domicile was established. Mynt is a protocol and Sovryn Community is the interface/governance description; neither is substituted for a legal issuer. Payment use is explicit, while redemption is into digital collateral. The GENIUS regime remains pre-effective in the opened implementation sources; this DASP value does not establish access through a particular venue or exempt other laws.
